tools.name: bilflo_list_clients
tools.description: The staffing company's clients (the customers contractors are placed with): id, business name, client code, phone, active flag. Each row carries the number of addresses and contacts; set include_details for the full address and contact lists. Bilflo returns every client at once, so this tool filters

tools.name: bilflo_get_client
tools.description: One client with its addresses and contacts. GET /v1/Clients/{clientId}.

tools.name: bilflo_list_client_contacts
tools.description: The contacts (people at the client: name, title, phone, email, active flag) of one client. GET /v1/Clients/contact/{clientId}.

tools.name: bilflo_list_client_addresses
tools.description: The addresses (work sites and billing addresses) of one client. GET /v1/Clients/addresses/{clientId}.

tools.name: bilflo_list_client_agreements
tools.description: The agreements (billing terms) on file for one client. GET /v1/Clients/agreements/{clientId}.

tools.name: bilflo_list_client_contract_pos
tools.description: The contract purchase orders of one client (PO numbers and amounts used for billing). GET /v1/Clients/contractPOs/{clientId}.

tools.name: bilflo_list_client_invoice_groups
tools.description: The contract invoice groups of one client (which jobs are invoiced together). GET /v1/Clients/contractInvoiceGroups/{clientId}.

tools.name: bilflo_get_contract_job
tools.description: One contract job (a contractor placed with a client): client, contractor, title, start/end dates, status, overtime rule, timecard method, per-diem/expense/sick-time flags, workers' comp code and burden. GET /v1/ContractJobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: bilflo_list_job_pay_bill_items
tools.description: The pay and bill rates (pay/bill items such as Regular, Overtime) of one contract job. GET /v1/ContractJobs/{jobId}/payBillItems.

tools.name: bilflo_list_job_approvers
tools.description: Who approves the timecards of one contract job. GET /v1/ContractJobs/{jobId}/approvers.

tools.name: bilflo_list_job_purchase_orders
tools.description: The purchase orders attached to one contract job. GET /v1/ContractJobs/{jobId}/purchaseOrders.

tools.name: bilflo_get_job_custom_fields
tools.description: The custom field values of one contract job. GET /v1/ContractJobs/{jobId}/customFields.

tools.name: bilflo_get_direct_hire
tools.description: One direct hire (a permanent placement): header, fee/split data, contacts and custom fields as Bilflo returns them. GET /v1/DirectHires/{jobId}.

tools.name: bilflo_get_contractor
tools.description: One contractor: profile (name, email, phone, address, W2/1099), jobs, checks paid, work status, benefit settings and custom fields. Social security number, date of birth and bank details are removed from the reply. GET /v1/Users/contractors/{contractorId}.

tools.name: bilflo_get_team_member
tools.description: One back-office team member (staffing company user): profile, roles and compensation settings. Government ids and bank details are removed. GET /v1/Users/teamMember/{id}.

tools.name: bilflo_list_overtime_rules
tools.description: The company's overtime rules (id, name, state). Use the ids with bilflo_update_contract_job. GET /v1/OvertimeRules.

tools.name: bilflo_get_company_setting
tools.description: One of the company's lookup lists: workers_comp_codes, payment_terms, remittances, burden_settings, benefit_rules, states or pay_bill_items. GET /v1/CompanySettings/{setting}.

tools.name: bilflo_list_custom_fields
tools.description: The company's custom fields (active and inactive) with type, requiredness per service offering and, for list fields, the selectable items. GET /v1/CustomFields.

tools.name: bilflo_list_custom_field_items
tools.description: The selectable items of one custom list field (id from bilflo_list_custom_fields). Items of a field named like personal data (SSN, date of birth, bank account, password) are not shown. GET /v1/CustomFields/items.

tools.name: bilflo_run_report
tools.description: Run one of the company's saved custom reports and return its rows. Report parameters are report specific key/value pairs, for example {"Start": "2026-01-01", "End": "2026-01-31"}. Reads data only. POST /v1/Reports/{reportId}/Execute.

tools.name: bilflo_create_client
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new client (customer) in Bilflo with the given business name and returns its id. It is visible to the whole staffing company and used for billing, so check bilflo_list_clients first to avoid a duplicate. POST /v1/Clients.

tools.name: bilflo_update_client
tools.description: WRITE: changes only the client fields you pass (business name, client code, phone, fax, active flag); the rest stay as they are. Setting is_active=false deactivates the client. PATCH /v1/Clients/{clientId}.

tools.name: bilflo_update_contract_job
tools.description: WRITE: changes only the contract job fields you pass (title, overtime rule, workers' comp code, burden, per-diem/expenses/sick-time/meal-period flags); the rest stay as they are. Pay and bill rates change payroll and invoices, so confirm values with the user. Client, contractor, dates and status can

tools.name: bilflo_terminate_contract_job
tools.description: WRITE: ends a contract job on the given date (the contractor stops being placed with the client; no more timecards are expected after it). Affects payroll and invoicing. A terminated job can be brought back with bilflo_reopen_contract_job. POST /v1/ContractJobs/terminate.

tools.name: bilflo_reopen_contract_job
tools.description: WRITE: reopens a terminated contract job (like the Open Job button): the job becomes active again, the end date is cleared, the contractor is made active and the missing timecards from the reopen date's week are created. Fails if the job is not terminated or the company plan has no room for another

tools.name: bilflo_update_contractor
tools.description: WRITE: changes only the contractor contact fields you pass (name, title, email, phone, address, company); the rest stay as they are. Tax, bank, social security number and activation are not changeable here. PATCH /v1/Users/contractors/{contractorId}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "bilflo_list_custom_field_items" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bilflo_list_client_contacts, bilflo_get_contractor, bilflo_create_client, bilflo_reopen_contract_job · Private data: bilflo_list_clients, bilflo_get_client, bilflo_list_client_contacts, bilflo_list_client_agreements, bilflo_get_direct_hire, bilflo_list_custom_field_items, bilflo_update_contractor · Public sink: bilflo_list_client_contacts, bilflo_get_contractor, bilflo_run_report, bilflo_create_client, bilflo_terminate_contract_job, bilflo_reopen_contract_job, bilflo_update_contractor · Destructive: bilflo_run_report, bilflo_terminate_contract_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bilflo_list_client_contacts, bilflo_get_contractor, bilflo_create_client, bilflo_reopen_contract_job · Private data: bilflo_list_clients, bilflo_get_client, bilflo_list_client_contacts, bilflo_list_client_agreements, bilflo_get_direct_hire, bilflo_list_custom_field_items, bilflo_update_contractor · Public sink: bilflo_list_client_contacts, bilflo_get_contractor, bilflo_run_report, bilflo_create_client, bilflo_terminate_contract_job, bilflo_reopen_contract_job, bilflo_update_contractor · Destructive: bilflo_run_report, bilflo_terminate_contract_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
